section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1974
title: Accidental Death by Sex The number of male victims under Accidental deaths was much more than females. The all-India average revealed 66.5 per cent as male victims and 33.5 per cent as female victims. The proportion for States was almost the same i.e., male involvement was 66.3 per cent and female involvement was 33.7 per cent but for Union Territories the involvement of males was higher, i.e., 74.0 per cent. Among metropolitan cities, percentage of male involvement was near the all-India average, i.e. 68.5 per cent and females involvement was 31.5 per cent. In Nagaland and Lakshadweep, males mere involved in all the accidental deaths. The States where male involvement was above 70 per cent numbered eleven, In Union Territories this number was seven and in Metropolitan cities this number was three. The details are presented in Table V. TABLE V\nStatewise distribution of Accidental Death by Sex, 1974
